_rule: Document B section 6. Every value here comes from a verified source, named below. Nothing is inferred and nothing is guessed. A missing value is reported, never filled in.

sources.schedule: Supabase event_calendar joined to events, project jlwopomkqeawrxlapwpc, read 26 September 2026. Supplies event, day, date and first-bout time.
sources.cutoff: events.booking_cutoff_minutes, same read. First bout minus the cutoff, written onto each card as an absolute UTC instant.
sources.doors: MuayTix's own published day-dated pages in this repository, which carry an explicit doors attribute. Not derived and not offset from the first bout.

sources.week_accent: Same six colours already verified and sourced for pages/homepage-v6/dynamic-data.json on 27 September 2026. Reused rather than re-sourced. Used here as a solid colour bar and button fill per event on the This Week schedule, replacing five identical white cards.
sources.hero_image: Owner-supplied URL, 30 September 2026, sent to replace the previous hero photo and lighten the scrim over it so the photo actually shows. static.tildacdn.com is blocked in this environment, so the image could not be opened and inspected directly here: the alt text below states only what the owner said the photo is (a Muay Thai fight in action at Rajadamnern Stadium), not any pose, fighter count or detail beyond that. Flag to Jason if the alt text does not match what is actually in the photo. Requested file name 'muay-thai-fight-action-rajadamnern-stadium-bangkok.jpg' cannot be set here: the URL is Tilda's own asset host and its file name is Tilda's internal id, not something this build controls.
sources.event_logos: Owner-supplied URLs, 30 September 2026, for all six event cards including All Star Fight: Elite Fighter. Five of the six are character-for-character the same URLs already sourced and recorded in pages/homepage-v6/dynamic-data.json on 27 September 2026, so treated as re-confirmed rather than re-verified. The sixth, Kiatpetch, is new and different: homepage-v6's Kiatpetch logo was recorded as missing because the URL given for it on 27 September was an exact duplicate of New Power's, so it was never used; this message gives Kiatpetch its own distinct URL (1000026562.jpg), closing that gap. static.tildacdn.com is blocked in this environment, so none of the six files has been opened or looked at: logo_alt below states only that the image is that event's logo, no visual detail invented. logo_tile risk carried over from homepage-v6's own note and not yet resolved either way: a logo drawn in dark artwork on transparency would disappear against these cards' white background, and it has not been possible to check which of the six that applies to.
sources.times: Owner, dictated by voice, 30 September 2026, going through the event cards on the preview build card by card. Doors and first bell for New Power and Petchyindee match what was already on file (doors.new-power, doors.petchyindee, and the old nights.schedule first-bout wording); event end for Rajadamnern Knockout, Petchyindee, RWS and Kiatpetch, and RWS's first bell at 7:10 PM, are new facts from this message, not previously recorded anywhere. New Power's event end was not given and is not inferred, see the events block.

_evergreen_only_note: Jason, 1 October 2026: Sunday 4 October (Kiatpetch) and Monday 5 October (Rajadamnern Knockout) on the This Week schedule should link to the evergreen event page, not a dated page, because the dated page for each doesn't exist yet. Checked, not assumed: pages/nights and pages/knockout-dated between them cover Kiatpetch through 27 September and Knockout through 2 October, with nothing for either event past those dates anywhere in this project. This is a fact about these two specific dates, not a rule about either series in general -- Knockout's own dated pages exist and are linked normally for every other date on the board -- so it is data here, not a hardcoded exception in gen.mjs, and needs a new entry (or removing an old one) the day a real dated page for one of these exists.
